result.violated_requirement: From the empty state (S0) a 1-yuan input (d2) must add one yuan and advance to the 1-yuan state S1; the mutant instead advances to the 0.5-yuan state S0_5, so the accumulated amount diverges from the coins inserted.
result.spec_basis: Input currency: d1 represents 0.5 yuan, d2 represents 1 yuan; the machine accumulates the total amount of money inserted.
